name: Extended Folder Compression for TinyPNG
author: RLDD

sections.description:
A simple tool to compress images in custom directories.

Features

☑ Use your TinyPNG API key to compress images in any directory

☑ Works with custom folders and subfolders

☑ Set a number of days back to look for eligible images

☑ Logs optimized images so they are never optimized more than once

☑ Manual process will run until all eligible images are compressed

☑ Automatic process will run every predetermined number of hours
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/extended-folder-compression directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the \’Plugins\’ screen in WordPress
  3. Configure from the WordPress admin Settings menu
sections.faq:
Will this run on the native WP uploads folder?

Yes, but it will only target native folders within uploads if the folder is specifically targeted.

How do users get started?

To get started, sign up for your TinyPNG API key at https://tinify.com/pricing/api
